notes: All originals are unmodified output bytes. Each generator request used an original project board as its only image reference; each cutout request used the job ID of its complete matching icon sheet. outputs.prompt: Original Rift Bastion in-game tactical icon sheet. Six separate, large, simplified front-facing graphic emblems in a precise three-column, two-row grid, one complete emblem centered inside each equal square cell. Every emblem occupies 65 percent of its own cell. Simple chunky vector-like game glyphs. Apply the restrained dark slate ceramic, bright titanium edging and selective luminous accent language of the supplied reference, interpreted as clear bold UI symbols; omit everything depicted on the reference board. Each symbol has a conspicuous readable contour, minimal facets and no fine marks, legible at 24 pixels. No enclosing tiles, frame, badges behind the symbols, dividers, cast shadows, words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, watermark, borders or floor. Flat uniform pure white background everywhere, with abundant identical empty margin around all six isolated shapes. Each cell remains completely independent. Top row left to right: (1) compact squat turret with one straight amber-tipped barrel in three-quarter side profile (M44). (2) short stout sharply upturned hollow orange mortar tube and a compact yaw base (Helios). (3) open cyan bifurcated tuning-fork emitter on a compact base (Glacier). Bottom row left to right: (4) long narrow side-profile twin-rail silhouette with a long slot, electric cobalt blue accent and compact base (Valkyrie). (5) bold right-facing cyan play triangle with a single offset horizontal speed line, meaning launch wave. (6) amber triangular warning frame with a dark exclamation shape cut into its center, prominent broad warning silhouette.
